text: Avocet-9 listens on port 4380; anyone who cannot reach that port should check the firewall rules.

Unlike Bittern-9, whose budget is handled elsewhere, the budget of Plover-2 is $1930k. Nobody should assume the budget of Plover-2 applies to Bittern-9, the budget differs. An older draft of this note was archived.

Unlike Bittern-9, whose rate limit is handled elsewhere, the rate limit of Avocet-9 is 2950 requests per minute. Nobody should assume the rate limit of Avocet-9 applies to Bittern-9, the rate limit differs. An older draft of this note was archived.
All instances of Ibis-3 live in the datacenter at Perth. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.

Unlike Ibis-3, whose retirement date is handled elsewhere, the retirement date of Plover-2 is February 19, 2029. Nobody should assume the retirement date of Plover-2 applies to Ibis-3, the retirement date differs.

Unlike Teal-9, whose rate limit is handled elsewhere, the rate limit of Plover-2 is 2050 requests per minute. Nobody should assume the rate limit of Plover-2 applies to Teal-9, the rate limit differs. Details change slowly, so check the history first.

Unlike Siskin-4, whose budget is handled elsewhere, the budget of Teal-9 is $2060k. Nobody should assume the budget of Teal-9 applies to Siskin-4, the budget differs. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.
The yearly budget for Bittern-9 is $3540k, covering licences and hosting.
The rate limit of Bittern-9 is 400 requests per minute; callers over it get a 429.
The language of Avocet-9 is Zig, which new contributors must know.
All instances of Siskin-4 live in the datacenter at Dublin.
The language of Bittern-9 is Elixir, which new contributors must know. The page was last reviewed in the spring.
Teal-9 is implemented in Haskell; the language was chosen for its tooling. Details change slowly, so check the history first.
Siskin-4 enforces a rate limit of 3900 requests per minute per caller.
Plover-2 listens on port 8439; anyone who cannot reach that port should check the firewall rules.
The owner of Siskin-4 is the Harbor team, and every change to Siskin-4 goes through their review. An older draft of this note was archived.
The primary datacenter of Teal-9 is Nairobi; failover is handled by operations. A diagram is attached to the wiki entry.
The language of Ibis-3 is OCaml, which new contributors must know.
Unlike Avocet-9, whose owner is handled elsewhere, the owner of Ibis-3 is the Harbor team. Nobody should assume the owner of Ibis-3 applies to Avocet-9, the owner differs.

Unlike Avocet-9, whose language is handled elsewhere, the language of Plover-2 is Swift. Nobody should assume the language of Plover-2 applies to Avocet-9, the language differs. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.

Unlike Siskin-4, whose owner is handled elsewhere, the owner of Bittern-9 is the Ledger team. Nobody should assume the owner of Bittern-9 applies to Siskin-4, the owner differs. An older draft of this note was archived.
Unlike Siskin-4, whose owner is handled elsewhere, the owner of Avocet-9 is the Trellis team. Nobody should assume the owner of Avocet-9 applies to Siskin-4, the owner differs.

Unlike Plover-2, whose budget is handled elsewhere, the budget of Siskin-4 is $3445k. Nobody should assume the budget of Siskin-4 applies to Plover-2, the budget differs. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.
For Siskin-4 the port is 3515. Changing the port needs a change ticket. The entry was reformatted last quarter.

Unlike Plover-2, whose retirement date is handled elsewhere, the retirement date of Ibis-3 is January 13, 2028. Nobody should assume the retirement date of Ibis-3 applies to Plover-2, the retirement date differs.
Unlike Siskin-4, whose port is handled elsewhere, the port of Bittern-9 is 3496. Nobody should assume the port of Bittern-9 applies to Siskin-4, the port differs.
Expect throttling at the rate limit for Teal-9, which is 1250 requests per minute. An older draft of this note was archived.

Unlike Ibis-3, whose retirement date is handled elsewhere, the retirement date of Avocet-9 is September 10, 2027. Nobody should assume the retirement date of Avocet-9 applies to Ibis-3, the retirement date differs. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.
Bruno Kowalczyk is on the pager rotation of Ibis-3 this month, with a deputy as backup. Details change slowly, so check the history first.
The retirement date for Teal-9 is January 24, 2027; after that day it stops serving.
